MoneyLaunderingCheck.name: Money Laundering Check
MoneyLaunderingCheck.definition: Status of an identity check to prevent money laundering. This includes the counter-terrorism check.

CreditQuality.name: Credit Quality
CreditQuality.definition: Credit quality for the clearing member.

ContactPoint.name: Contact Point
ContactPoint.definition: Number, physical or virtual address, used for communication.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Specific identification assigned to a party.

TaxationConditions.name: Taxation Conditions
TaxationConditions.definition: Taxation parameters which apply to an individual person or to an organisation.

Domicile.name: Domicile
Domicile.definition: Location in which a person is permanently domiciled (the place of a person's permanent home).

Residence.name: Residence
Residence.definition: Location from which the affairs of a company are directed or location in which a person resides (the place of a person's home).

PowerOfAttorney.name: Power Of Attorney
PowerOfAttorney.definition: Power of attorney which is held by the party.

CloseLinkSecurity.name: Close Link Security
CloseLinkSecurity.definition: Security for which a close link with a party is identified.

RelatedCareOf.name: Related Care Of
RelatedCareOf.definition: Identifies a Postal address of the addressee that is accepting the correspondence for an intended recipient.
